svg.title: The Phosphoros decade, 2027 to 2036
svg.desc: To scale. 27 workstreams and milestones in five lanes, from the proof experiments to the deadline. The critical path is drawn with thicker bars. Earth-like Venus, in the simulation, comes on 30 September 2036, 92 d before the deadline.
